entities.summary: Palazzo Grazioli is a building situated at Via del Plebiscito 102 between the Palazzo Doria Pamphili and Palazzo Altieri in Rome, Italy. It is located in an area rich in archaeological remains of ancient Rome, which has been the result of numerous modifications and restoration works carried out by several Roman noble families who lived there over the centuries.
